name: Dicksons Nurses Are Angels Without Wings Figurine
seoTitle: Nurses Are Angels Without Wings Figurine
metaDescription: A 6 inch blue resin angel figurine saying nurses are angels without wings. A sweet keepsake to thank a nurse, mark retirement, or honor Nurses Week.
summary: A small blue angel figurine that calls nurses angels without wings, a sentimental desk or shelf keepsake for the nurse who made a difference.
whyItWorks: Patients and families remember the nurse who explained things kindly, warmed a blanket, or checked in one more time before the end of shift. A little angel figurine carrying the words nurses are angels without wings captures that feeling in a way that a gift card cannot, and it gives the nurse something to look at on a rough day.

At 6 inches it is compact enough for a nightstand, a home office shelf, or a windowsill, and the blue finish has a calm, gentle look. It makes a thoughtful choice for Nurses Week from a manager to a small team, or as a retirement token alongside a card signed by the unit. It is budget friendly, which helps if you want to give one to several nurses who cared for a family member. Wrap it carefully and add a short note naming the moment you will not forget.
goodToKnow: Resin is fairly sturdy but can chip, so pack it carefully.
Sentimental decor is a matter of taste, so it fits best for someone who already keeps keepsakes.
Check the listing photos to confirm the shade of blue and the wording placement.

faq.q: Is this a good thank you from a patient's family?
faq.a: Yes, it is one of the most fitting uses, especially paired with a card describing the care your family received.

faq.q: Is it too small to feel like a real gift?
faq.a: At 6 inches it is modest, but the message carries it, and it pairs nicely with flowers or a card.
